lead_headline: Pizzeria Lui shutters after 10 years, Church and Union closes in LoDo — 3 new closure leads land as July restaurant churn accelerates

restaurant.blurb: 3 new leads today: Pizzeria Lui closed (Neapolitan, 10 years), Church and Union Denver shuttered LoDo flagship, Dairy Queen Westminster. Active pipeline 296 (159 openings, 137 closures).

liquor.blurb: 1 new application today: Waterway lands fermented malt license at Cherry Creek North (3875 E Cherry Creek North Dr). Meanwhile, 8 status shifts — Belles and Boots (Blake St), Skyline Beer Garden (Arapahoe), Fortissimo Dueling Pianos (14th St), and Foraged (Blake St) all flip delinquent. RiNo Grog Shop clears delinquency to active. The Pit Stop (Wadsworth) goes live. Week's application surge settles after yesterday's 88-app explosion — 7-day total now 425 vs. zero prior week as post-freeze licensing pipeline normalizes.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention yesterday — Thursday sets a new weekly low, dropping below Wednesday's 3-cite floor. Week crawls to 63 mentions across 17 sources, now down 16% from last week's 75 as the three-week growth streak collapses. Instagram leads at 18, Facebook 12, Denver Post and Reddit tied at 8, Hoodline 3. Thursday's lone pickup: Instagram post on Colorado drought conditions. Daily acquisition rate now 1.0 mention vs. 10.7/day needed to match prior week — the slowdown deepens. Source count flat at 17 outlets. Three days left in tracking window. At current pace, week will close 30+ mentions below prior period, confirming first sequential decline after sustained spring growth.

subscriptions.blurb: Net ±0 yesterday (2 new, 2 canceled) — the Wednesday micro-bounce evaporates as churn resumes. MTD ticks to −16 (−1.0/day), 90-day cumulative +92. Past 7 days deteriorate to −20 net (13 new, 33 canceled) vs. prior week's −6 — a 14-subscriber swing that extends July's losing streak. The single-day recovery proved ephemeral: cancellations immediately resumed 1:1 ratio with acquisitions. Since July 1, just 19 new subscribers against 43 cancellations for −24 monthly net. The pattern is unambiguous: July tracks as worst acquisition month on record with churn running 2.3:1 against sign-ups across past fortnight. YTD net holds at +210 (+1.1/day) solely on Q1-Q2 momentum. If July's pace persists through month-end, it will mark the first negative monthly close in tracking history.
